Adesrɛ bi
1 # 1 Pe 4.5 Afei mehyɛ wo Onyankopɔn ne Kristo Yesu a ɔbɛbu ateasefoɔ ne awufoɔ atɛn n’ahoyie ne n’ahennie mu no anim. 2#Aso 20.20; 20.31 Pae mu ka asɛm no, gyina mu ɛberɛ a ɛyɛ ne deɛ ɛnyɛ mu, yi atɛn, ka anim, tu fo, abodwokyɛre ne nkyerɛkyerɛ nyinaa mu. 3#2 Ti 1.13; 1 Ti 4.1 Na ɛberɛ bi bɛba a wɔrentie nkyerɛkyerɛ pa a ɛyɛ no. Na ɛnam sɛ wɔn aso mu yɛ wɔn hene nti, wɔbɛsoa akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ aboa so, sɛdeɛ wɔn ara wɔn akɔnnɔ teɛ. 4#1 Ti 4.7; 2 Te 2.11 Na wɔbɛyi wɔn aso afiri nokorɛ ho, na wɔadane akɔtie anansesɛm. 5#2 Ti 2.3 Na wo deɛ, ma w’ani nna hɔ wɔ adeɛ nyinaa mu, mia w’ani hunu amane, yɛ ɔsɛmpakafoɔ adwuma, wie wo som no koraa.
Paulo awie ɔno ara n’adwuma
6 # Flp 2.17 Na me deɛ, wɔanya rehwie me agu sɛ ahwiesa, na me berɛ a mede bɛsɔre ha ahi. 7#1 Ko 9.25; 1 Ti 6.12; Flp 3.14 Ɔko pa no, mako; mmirika no, mawie tu; gyidie no, makora. 8#2 Ti 2.5; 1 Pe 5.4; Yak 1.12; Adi 2.10 Deɛ aka a ɛda me hɔ ne tenenee abotire a Awurade, ɔtemmufoɔ tenenee no de bɛma me Ɛda no, na ɛnyɛ me nko, na mmom wɔn a wɔdɔ n’ahoyie no nyinaa nso bi.
N’ani gyina Timoteo
9 # 2 Ti 4.21; 1.4 Bɔ mmɔden bra me nkyɛn ntɛm! 10#Kol 4.14 Ɛfiri sɛ Dema apɛ seesei wiase agya me hɔ, na wasim kɔ Tesalonika, Kreske kɔ Galatia, Tito kɔ Dalmatia. 11#Aso 15.37; Kol 4.10 Luka nko na ɔne me wɔ ha. Fa Marko ka wo ho bra, na ɔyɛ ma me ɔsom mu. 12#Aso 20.4; Efe 6.21; Kol 4.7 Tihiko deɛ, masoma no Efeso. 13Sɛ woreba a, fa me batakari a megyaa no Karpo nkyɛn wɔ Troa ne nwoma no brɛ me, ne titire no kokwanwoma no.
Ɔtomfoɔ Aleksandro
14 # 1 Ti 1.20; 2 Sa 3.39; Dwom 28.4 Aleksandro, kɔbere dwumfoɔ no, yɛɛ me bɔne pii. Awurade bɛtua no ka sɛdeɛ ne nnwuma teɛ. 15Ɔno na wo nso hwɛ wo ho yie wɔ ne ho; ɛfiri sɛ ɔsii yɛn nsɛm ano kwan bebree.
Gyeɛ a wɔgye Paulo
16 # 2 Ti 1.15 Me nyiano a ɛdi kan no mu, obiara ammɛgyina m’akyi, na wɔn nyinaa gyaa me hɔ; wɔmmmu nngu wɔn so. 17#Aso 23.11; 27.23 Na Awurade gyinaa m’akyi, na ɔhyɛɛ me den, na wɔafa me so awie asɛnka no, na amanaman mufoɔ nyinaa ate; na wɔyii me firii gyata anomu. 18Na Awurade bɛyi me afiri bɔne nyinaa mu, na wagye me akɔ ne soro ahennie no mu; ɔno na animuonyam wɔ no mmerɛ santen mfesanten. Amen.
Nkradie ne nkyea
19 # Aso 18.2; Rom 16.3; 2 Ti 1.16 Mekyea Priska ne Akwila ne Onesiforo fiefoɔ! 20#Aso 19.22; 20.4; 21.29 Erasto kaa Korinto, na megyaa Trofimo wɔ Mileto a na ɔyare. 21Bɔ mmɔden bra ansa na awɔ berɛ aba. Eubulo ne Pude ne Lino ne Klaudia ne anuanom nyinaa kyeakyea wo. 22Awurade ne wo honhom ntena. Adom nka wo.

pageProps.chapterText:
Afei mehyɛ wo Onyankopɔn ne Kristo Yesu a ɔbɛbu ateasefoɔ ne awufoɔ atɛn n’ahoyie ne n’ahennie mu no anim. Pae mu ka asɛm no, gyina mu ɛberɛ a ɛyɛ ne deɛ ɛnyɛ mu, yi atɛn, ka anim, tu fo, abodwokyɛre ne nkyerɛkyerɛ nyinaa mu. Na ɛberɛ bi bɛba a wɔrentie nkyerɛkyerɛ pa a ɛyɛ no. Na ɛnam sɛ wɔn aso mu yɛ wɔn hene nti, wɔbɛsoa akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ aboa so, sɛdeɛ wɔn ara wɔn akɔnnɔ teɛ. Na wɔbɛyi wɔn aso afiri nokorɛ ho, na wɔadane akɔtie anansesɛm. Na wo deɛ, ma w’ani nna hɔ wɔ adeɛ nyinaa mu, mia w’ani hunu amane, yɛ ɔsɛmpakafoɔ adwuma, wie wo som no koraa.

Na me deɛ, wɔanya rehwie me agu sɛ ahwiesa, na me berɛ a mede bɛsɔre ha ahi. Ɔko pa no, mako; mmirika no, mawie tu; gyidie no, makora. Deɛ aka a ɛda me hɔ ne tenenee abotire a Awurade, ɔtemmufoɔ tenenee no de bɛma me Ɛda no, na ɛnyɛ me nko, na mmom wɔn a wɔdɔ n’ahoyie no nyinaa nso bi.

Bɔ mmɔden bra me nkyɛn ntɛm! Ɛfiri sɛ Dema apɛ seesei wiase agya me hɔ, na wasim kɔ Tesalonika, Kreske kɔ Galatia, Tito kɔ Dalmatia. Luka nko na ɔne me wɔ ha. Fa Marko ka wo ho bra, na ɔyɛ ma me ɔsom mu. Tihiko deɛ, masoma no Efeso. Sɛ woreba a, fa me batakari a megyaa no Karpo nkyɛn wɔ Troa ne nwoma no brɛ me, ne titire no kokwanwoma no.

Aleksandro, kɔbere dwumfoɔ no, yɛɛ me bɔne pii. Awurade bɛtua no ka sɛdeɛ ne nnwuma teɛ. Ɔno na wo nso hwɛ wo ho yie wɔ ne ho; ɛfiri sɛ ɔsii yɛn nsɛm ano kwan bebree.

Me nyiano a ɛdi kan no mu, obiara ammɛgyina m’akyi, na wɔn nyinaa gyaa me hɔ; wɔmmmu nngu wɔn so. Na Awurade gyinaa m’akyi, na ɔhyɛɛ me den, na wɔafa me so awie asɛnka no, na amanaman mufoɔ nyinaa ate; na wɔyii me firii gyata anomu. Na Awurade bɛyi me afiri bɔne nyinaa mu, na wagye me akɔ ne soro ahennie no mu; ɔno na animuonyam wɔ no mmerɛ santen mfesanten. Amen.

Mekyea Priska ne Akwila ne Onesiforo fiefoɔ! Erasto kaa Korinto, na megyaa Trofimo wɔ Mileto a na ɔyare. Bɔ mmɔden bra ansa na awɔ berɛ aba. Eubulo ne Pude ne Lino ne Klaudia ne anuanom nyinaa kyeakyea wo. Awurade ne wo honhom ntena. Adom nka wo.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
